'''darthwells The Smoking Gun (TRM)''' is a [[Light]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[darthwells]]
* '''Published:''' 15 December 2001 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Theed Palace]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Yavin 4: Massassi War Room|Premiere-L-yavin4massassiwarroom.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' Yavin 4: Massassi War Room
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PTheed Yavin 4 Massassi War Room darthw.txt |Download]]

the tr mains i've used since r3

== Strategy ==

I've built this deck to help combat darkside lsc and ivasion. use your suicide squads on the ground ,as always with tr mains, while you also have a decent space as well to control the naboo system for invasion or combat syc/ties. i've been thinking of cutting boushh, and strike blocked x2 for epp leia, epp han, and chewie enraged. let me know what you think. also i don't have a qui-gon with lightsaber yet.
